title: pseudognaphalium rosillense
intro: Pseudognaphalium rosillense, commonly known as Rosy cudweed or Rosy everlasting, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is native to Mexico and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in the treatment of skin conditions, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pseudognaphalium rosillense include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis, sore throats, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
